prompt: Create one complete, realistic, isolated rug as a regular household product. Visible geometry and style: 大面积矩形，平铺于地面; 侘寂风. Use materials ['天然编织纤维'] and colors ['米杏色']. Preserve ['粗编织质感，米杏主色调']. Regularize temporary disorder with ['移除表面茶几、坐墩等遮挡物']. Simplify modeling complexity with ['简化编织纹理密度，做整体平整处理']: use clean broad surfaces, shallow orderly folds, separated non-intersecting parts, and avoid tangled fabric or dense tiny wrinkles. Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'bilateral', 'completionRule': '按可见纹理对称补全遮挡区域'} and ['按周边编织纹理补全被遮挡区域']. Texture rule: 密集粗编织颗粒纹理; 延续均匀编织纹理，无空白断层. Target plausible real-world dimensions are approximately 1.70 m wide, 2.50 m deep and 0.03 m high. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. These are category-prior estimates rather than pixel measurements. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
